Your picked start is used exactly — position and orientation — when every start guard passes: the map is authored at its pad alignment and the rows start at the row end nearest it. If a guard refuses it, the nearest designed start is used and the result names the guard and how far it moved. A placed pre-start is used exactly where placed. Verify runs the same guards now.
